title: REQ · Modal shows a contribution history list with loading and error states from the backend client
summary: Render history from listMine with loading, empty and error states
description: Context: history is fetched best-effort and failures are swallowed; entries show only prompt and state. Desired behavior: history list loaded through listMine shows prompts with status, with visible loading, empty and load-error states. Expected result: players see their prior ideas or why none appear. Why: history requirement of the intent.
acceptance_criteria: Given listMine resolves with contributions, when the dialog opens, then each prompt appears in the 'Your suggestions' list marked Sent
Given listMine is pending, then 'Loading suggestions…' shows; given it resolves empty, then 'No suggestions yet' shows
Given listMine rejects, then role=alert 'Could not load your suggestions' shows and submitting still works

out_of_scope: New backend endpoint for other players' contributions
preserve: Merge of in-flight entries with loaded history

definition_of_done: History states render for each outcome
